clips.title: The story
paras: In Blackfathom Deeps and along Ashenvale's coast, Corrupted Brain Stem specimens come from twisted naga and satyrs. Gershala Nightwhisper of Auberdine studies the deformities caused by reckless magic. Night elf scholars hope the findings can help keep the blood elves from suffering the same fate.

Naga and satyrs bear the marks of forbidden magic and demonic pacts. Long ago, reckless kaldorei highborne became serpent-like aquatic beasts and demonic horned fiends. Their brain stems show heavy physical mutation, proof of how deeply corruptive energies altered the nervous systems of beings who were once elves.

Gershala Nightwhisper watches troubling rumors about the blood elves of the Eastern Kingdoms from Auberdine. She fears their use of demonic sorcery will create another generation of monsters on Azeroth, so she sends adventurers into Blackfathom Deeps. By examining naga and satyr tissues, she hopes to trace magical degeneration before another elven culture is lost.
